sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Postponed Reward is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, you fucked up with the evidence in a very embarrassing way, but sure, I'll keep my word. I'll get you your fucking container. But now I'm gonna ask you for something else, since things got so ugly."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
Seasonal change: the quest requires 5 Lega Medals.
- Hand over a Lega Medal to Ref

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
Seasonal change: the quest awards a barter for the Secure container Theta at Ref LL3, instead of the container directly.
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 1× Secure container Theta
- Unlocks Parquet Hideout floor style
"All right, you've earned your reward. But you better know I'm not gonna take any more of your bullshit. You start digging again, you'll end up like that old champion."
